activity.notes: Abu Zakariya Yahya established independent Hafsid rule in Ifriqiya in 1229 after repudiating Almohad authority and ruled until his death in 1249. Tunis was the political capital of the Hafsid state. Contemporary titulature evolved during his reign: he initially used amir and later adopted Amir al-Mu'minin, while modern dynastic and numismatic references commonly style him Sultan. ATLAS therefore uses Sultan as the normalized ruler role for the full 1229–1249 Hafsid reign rather than splitting a single continuous rule solely over titulature.
